_comment: systems/betrothals.js — promising the House's children (even infants) to a rival House's child, a lord of your realm's house, a foreign crown's prince or princess, or a realm's nobility. Terms: whose House the couple's line belongs to, a ward/hostage arrangement, the dowry in coin and land. The promise binds while it stands (truces, kinship, lords' favour) and costs whoever breaks it. All rolls are hash rolls on this system's own key.
_price: The dowry their side asks, in gold, before the terms: base by kind, times status (their weight over yours, square-rooted, clamped), less what they think of you. A negative ask means their side pays you.
_line: line 'ours': their child takes your House's name and their children are yours (they ask more); 'theirs': your child goes to them (they ask less). Shares of the kind's base price.
_ward: ward 'oursThere': your child is raised at their court until the wedding, a pledge of good faith (they ask less); 'theirsHere': their child is raised at yours (they ask more, and you hold a hostage).
_ai: Monthly, on a hash roll: a side whose child's match fell from grace (your Prestige under fallShare of what it was at the promise) looks for a better match; a maimed child of yours (blinded, gelded, barred from rule) may be refused; a rival head of little honour breaks it when the feud warms.
_houses: Rival Houses among themselves (yearly): Houses on good terms promise their young children; a promise is broken when their regard sours, and kept with a wedding when both are grown.
_offers: Offers to you (monthly hash roll): a House or crown on good terms with a child the right age proposes a match. One at a time; it stands offerDays.
_vassalWard: A child held by a vassal for a match (yours raised in his hall, or his at your court): the lord gains favourPerMonth favour each month, up to favourCap.
_issue: Children of a promised match, a yearly hash roll (chance) while the mother is motherFrom-motherTo, up to max. line 'ours': of your House, they come to the seat with their parent; 'theirs': of the other House. A royal line with your blood gives a claim by blood (bloodClaim; bloodClaimHeir when one is the crown's eldest child; bloodClaimRuler when one is crowned); a rival's eases the feud (rivalFeud).
_crowns: Realms among themselves (CrownMatches): yearly, two realms at peace, allied or with relations at tieMin both ways, promise royal children aged up to maxAge within ageGap years (chance). Weekly a truce (truceDays) and relations +relations up to relationsCap; war breaks it (breakRelations); at 16 they wed and the realms ally (relations at least wedRelations).
